acceptanceCriteria.statement: Spine conformance (Rule 15 / SPINE-CONFORMANCE.md): (1) driver connectivity — every scalar surfaced or read (D12 raw, eccentricity, D13, D16, metallicity, composition/density, age, radius, shellThickness, raw tidal Io-ratio) is D-slot-backed or a named derivation; any archetype constant carries its deriving-increment name; (2) named consumer — every emitted field/module names its reader from the ROADMAP-v2 DAG (E1/V2-1 for the vector + scalar helpers + presets module; no dead fields); (3) taxonomy registration — no unregistered lab controls; planet-archetypes drift guards stay green.

verifyVia.input: Read the diff + BUILD notes conformance table; run npx vitest run tests/planet-archetypes.test.js
verifyVia.observable: All three checks pass; each new field's consumer column cites a ROADMAP-v2 increment; drift-guard suite green

acceptanceCriteria.statement: ZERO behavioral change — the refactor gate. Every archetype-mapped preset builds a byte-identical carrier (height and all carrier fields) at fixed seeds before vs after V2-0; driversToTune(D_EARTH) === null and magmaDriversToTune(MAGMA_REF) === null are preserved; the full vitest suite passes at the same test count as pre-change.

verifyVia.input: Headless carrier build for all archetype-mapped presets at seeds {1,2,3,7,42} on pre-change and post-change checkouts; full npx vitest run
verifyVia.observable: Float32Array byte-equality per preset/seed; both tune-null anchors hold; suite green, count unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.statement: baseStep scalar extraction: per-body scalar derivations (thermalState, shellThickness, rawTidal/Io-ratio, radiogenic/size-vigor terms, radialStrain, liquidStability) are exported as pure named helpers from the baseStep module; the existing baseStep test suite (which pins the exact scalar values) passes unchanged; helpers return the same values the grid op produced for identical inputs.

verifyVia.input: Import the helpers in a headless test; run the existing worldengine-base-interior / baseStep suites
verifyVia.observable: Helper outputs equal the grid-op-internal values on the pinned fixtures; suites green unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.statement: DRIVER_PRESETS extraction: an importable module exports all 17 driver-preset vectors (including Mars and Hot Jupiter, which have data but no archetype mapping); the lab consumes the module (no duplicated inline literal remains); planet-archetypes.test.js imports the module instead of string-scraping planet-lod-lab.html; exported values deep-equal the pre-extraction lab literals.

verifyVia.input: node import of the presets module; grep the lab HTML for a residual literal; run the archetype test suite
verifyVia.observable: 17 entries deep-equal to the pre-extraction values; lab imports the module; tests no longer read the HTML as text

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Condition-vector threading: route()→writeBodyRelief carries the full body condition-vector (composition/density, age, radius, eccentricity + raw tidal Io-ratio as a named field, shellThickness) alongside the existing bundle, with values derived from _fp; tune builders receive the widened bundle and ignore unknown fields (byte-safety asserted by AC1); the raw Io-ratio is exposed so m_hp is computable on the production path, not just the lab fallback.

verifyVia.input: Headless route() call with an instrumented writer capturing the bundle at the writeBodyRelief seam
verifyVia.observable: All named vector fields present with _fp-derived (non-default) values for presets that define them; raw Io-ratio field present and un-calibrated

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Live wiring intact: the lab page loads and steps through archetype presets without console errors; the drivers bundle visible via _lab shows the new condition-vector fields; the worldengine-fieldviz.html harness (the one non-test baseStep caller, outside the test guard) still loads and renders without errors.

verifyVia.input: chrome-devtools: load planet-lod-lab.html on the dev server, step 4+ presets, inspect _lab state/drivers; load worldengine-fieldviz.html
verifyVia.observable: Zero console errors on both pages; presets render; new fields present in the live bundle
